clues.it: Luca era nella 7ª colonna e nella 1ª riga, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Luca was in the 7th column and in the 1st row, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Fabio era accanto a un'ancora, a nord di Carla e in Plancia.
clues.en: Fabio was beside an anchor, north of Carla and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Tea era nella 3ª riga, accanto a una sedia e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Tea was in the 3rd row, beside a chair and north of Elena.

clues.it: Elena era nella 3ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Elena was in the 3rd column, in the 4th row and north of Carla.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 5ª riga e accanto a una cassa, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 5th row and beside a crate, but was not beside a plant.

clues.it: Carla era a nord di Marta e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Carla was north of Marta and in the Galley.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a una sedia e in una stanza diversa da Paolo.
clues.en: Marta was beside a chair and in a different room from Paolo.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 6ª colonna e nella 8ª riga, ma non era accanto a un'ancora.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 6th column and in the 8th row, but was not beside an anchor.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Elena lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Elena's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 8ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 6th.

steps.it: Luca può stare solo nella 7ª colonna: escludendola, a Tea resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Luca can only be in the 7th column: ruling it out leaves Tea a single square: row 3rd, column 2nd.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 6ª colonna: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 6th column: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 6th, column 5th.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 1ª colonna.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 1st column.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 9ª riga: escludendola, a Marta resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 7th, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 seduta su una sedia» non torna senza Giada: deve stare in riga 9ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 sitting on a chair” cannot add up without Giada: they must be at row 9th, column 4th.
